info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Account Management Accounts Receivable-spec
info.description: The Accounts Receivable Management API facilitates the creation and management of customer accounts ensuring efficient tracking of receivables. This API enables businesses to initiate new accounts, link them with payment records, and maintain up-to-date information on outstanding invoices. Typically used by finance and accounting teams, the API streamlines the process of managing customer debts, improving cash flow and financial reporting. Integration with existing banking systems enables seamless transaction processing and reconciliation.

post.summary: Create a new accounts receivable entry.
post.description: This endpoint allows the creation of a new accounts receivable record for tracking outstanding payments. Provide the necessary details in the request body to create the entry successfully.
